numeric_contract.finite_half: Round-to-nearest, ties-to-even with gradual underflow and overflow to infinity. This intentionally replaces the observed truncation-toward-zero behavior of old formatted sust.p stores in the NVVM path; existing NVRTC formatted stores remain unchanged and retain the original nine mismatching cells; the expanded mixed-resource matrix adds two more NVRTC rounding mismatches.
numeric_contract.nan: Converted NaNs remain NaNs, without a payload/sign guarantee. Untouched physical channels preserve all bits including NaN payloads and signed zero.
numeric_contract.constant_folding: Shared FloatToHalf uses full-discarded-bit RN-even, fixing ties and tiny subnormal rounding across compiler constant-folding users.
numeric_contract.generic_nvvm_conversion: Float32-to-Half uses llvm.nvvm.f2h.rn and a mechanical i16-to-Half bitcast; serializer retains its NVVM intrinsic identity. This avoids libNVVM O3 fptrunc turning low-payload signaling NaN into infinity.

repeatability_failure.scope: Bounded read-only diagnosis; no tracked file/binary modifications, no input or oracle changes, no performance measurements accepted from diagnostics.
repeatability_failure.conclusion: The shader assumes its uninitialized static aggregate state is zero before assigning it. Both CUDA source and NVVM emit that state as uninitialized per-invocation local KernelContext storage. Explicit flag/visits initializers are preserved; state has no initializer body from the first dumped IR. This is a shared initialization/fixture semantic issue exposed by repeated dispatch, not an NVVM-only performance result.
repeatability_failure.inference: Reused GPU local storage makes later reads observe nonzero previous state; source/PTX prove undefined initial bytes, while host debugger proves the third launch returns32zero failure sentinels instead of6400..6431. GPU local-memory contents were not directly inspected.
repeatability_failure.open_semantic_decision: Confirm intended bare static aggregate initialization guarantee before deciding whether producer initialization must be synthesized or the fixture needs an explicit initializer. No fix authorized/applied in this bounded diagnosis.
